action: A rabbit, at first crumpled upright beside a wall corner, stretches out into a crouching side-view rabbit and slides right along the floor until it exits off the right edge.
identity_gap: In the early frames the head is not the doodle's head: the doodle's horizontal snout-and-cheek block becomes a small crumpled loop or pentagon on a vertically squeezed body, so the character only matches the doodle (mirrored) from about frame 5 on.
notes: Frames 1-3 read as a tangled vertical squiggle with ears rather than a rabbit; frame 4 abruptly swaps in larger ears and a snout facing the other way, frame 5 jumps in scale and position, and frame 7 suddenly shrinks the head at the right edge. Frames 5-8 keep the doodle's stroke habits (straight polyline segments, open ear wedges, single front-leg notch, bumpy back line).
